issues.description: A kitesurf wearable needs a defined seal at the shell joint, screws, charging contacts, and optical window; none is specified.
issues.fix: Specify gaskets or overmolding, sealing geometry, compression limits, and an assembled-unit ingress test.
issues.rule_citation: Verify enclosure ingress protection by test — IEC 60529.

issues.description: The optical sensor window and light seal appear in the BOM but have no material, geometry, retention method, or assembly process.
issues.fix: Add controlled drawings and an assembly method for the window and light seal; validate optical performance after sealing.
issues.rule_citation: Define mating features and assembly method before tooling — Protolabs injection molding design guide.

issues.description: The LiPo cell is listed without a specified protection circuit, retention method, or routing that prevents lead pinching during shell closure.
issues.fix: Specify a protected cell or protection circuit, a cell restraint, and a wire-routing and inspection procedure.
issues.rule_citation: Safety requirements and tests for portable lithium cells and batteries — IEC 62133-2.

issues.description: The strap material and finish do not specify resistance to UV, saltwater, sunscreen, or repeated flexing in the intended use.
issues.fix: Set grade and qualification requirements for weathering, chemical exposure, tear strength, and flex life before approving the strap mold.
issues.rule_citation: Accelerated exposure of plastics to laboratory light sources — ISO 4892-2.

issues.description: Strap attachment hardware is in the BOM but its parts, retention geometry, and assembly method are undefined.
issues.fix: Specify pins or other attachment hardware, mating features, installation steps, and a strap pull-test requirement.
issues.rule_citation: Define mating features and assembly method before tooling — Protolabs injection molding design guide.

issues.description: The charging contacts have no specified base metal, plating, or corrosion acceptance criteria for saltwater exposure.
issues.fix: Specify contact material and plating, isolate dissimilar metals where needed, and qualify assembled contacts for salt-fog exposure.
issues.rule_citation: Salt mist corrosion test method — IEC 60068-2-11.

issues.description: Minimum wall draft is 1.33°: enough for a polished finish, short of the ~3° a textured finish ('MT-11010 light texture · Pink #FFC0CB') needs.
issues.fix: Increase draft to 3° on textured faces, or specify a lighter texture / polished finish.
issues.rule_citation: Draft ≥1° plus 1° per 0.025 mm texture depth — Protolabs injection molding design guidelines; measured with text-to-cad DFM skill (mold_tool.py, MIT) ported to OCCT

measurement.label: measured
measurement.source_or_assumption: Min wall draft vs pull +Z: lowest-draft B-rep wall face ≥ 6.31 mm² (curved, 33.09 mm² at [0.0, -0.0, 0.4]) — text-to-cad DFM skill (mold_tool.py, MIT) ported to OCCT

issues.description: Projected area along +Z: 1250 mm² (part silhouette, per cavity). Estimated clamp force ≈ 6.4 t (Estimate: area in² × 3.0 t/in² for PC/ABS × 1.1 safety) — per cavity; a family tool moulding both shells in one shot roughly doubles it.
issues.fix: Quote on a press ≥ 10 t; keep both shells in one family mould only if tonnage allows.
issues.rule_citation: Clamp force ≈ projected area × cavity-pressure factor (2-5 t/in²) — Protolabs injection molding design guidelines; silhouette raster from text-to-cad DFM skill (mold_tool.py, MIT) ported to OCCT

measurement.label: measured
measurement.source_or_assumption: Silhouette along +Z, raster 0.11 mm — text-to-cad DFM skill (mold_tool.py, MIT) ported to OCCT

issues.description: Measured wall 1.50-1.50 mm is within the PC/ABS 1.2-3.5 mm range; keep bosses/ribs ≤ 60% of nominal wall to avoid sink.
issues.fix: No change to nominal wall; core bosses and ribs to ≤ 60% of the wall.
issues.rule_citation: PC/ABS wall 1.2-3.5 mm, ribs/bosses ≤ 60% of wall — Protolabs injection molding design guidelines

measurement.label: measured
measurement.source_or_assumption: 5th percentile of 3120 ray samples into the material (median 1.5 mm)

issues.description: The shell mating-face and split-line requirements lack a datum scheme and a stack-up covering both molded shells and their alignment features.
issues.fix: Define functional datums and a closed-shell inspection method; calculate the stack-up before releasing tool drawings.
issues.rule_citation: Geometrical tolerancing requires defined datum references for controlled relationships — ISO 1101 and ISO 5459.

issues.description: The screw specification and boss pilot are given, but boss depth, outer diameter, engagement length, and installation torque are not defined for repeatable self-tapping assembly.
issues.fix: Detail the boss geometry and screw engagement, then validate driving torque, stripping torque, and repeated assembly on molded samples.
issues.rule_citation: Size molded screw bosses for the selected fastener and validate assembly — Protolabs injection molding design guide.

See also 47 CFR 15.19, 47 CFR 15.101, 47 CFR 15.109.
